Indian Standard

SPECIFICATION AND TESTING FOR 

FIFTH WHEEL KING PIN FOR SEMI-TRAILERS 

PART 1 SIZE 60 

(First Revision) 



1. Scope — Specifies tho dimensions and testing procedure for the size 50 ( ^ 50 8 mm ) fifth wheel 
king pin. In addition, this standard specifies the dimensional characteristics necessary for mounting 
and interchangeabihty. 

2. Terminology — For the purpose of this standard, the definitions given in IS : 7774-1975 'Glossary 
of terms relating to transport tractors and trailers: Part 1 Basic terms and Part 2 Dimensions and 
weights' shall apply fl 

3. Dimensions and Tolerances 

3.1 The basic functional dimensions and tolerances of fifth wheel king pin shall be as given in Fig. 1.

3.2 The dimensional characteristics for mounting and interchangeability for fifth wheel king pin shall 
conform to the details given in Fig. 2. 

3.3 The dimensions of gauge, details of load applications and fixture for applying load 'C are given 
in Fig. 3 to 5. 

4. Material 

4.1 The material for fifth wheel king pin shall be such as to withstand the drawbar pull test as 
specified in 5.1. Some of the suitable materials are given in Appendix A for information. 

5. Tests 

5.0 The following tests shall be carried out on fifth wheal king pin used for trailers. 

5.1 Drawbar Puff Test — The king pin and its mounting shall withstand the following loads without 
failure: 

a) Load A of 272 kN in fore and aft direction, 

b) A dynamic (cycling) load B of 113 kN for 500 000 cycles, 

c) A torque load C of 14 400 Nm for 100 000 cycles (refer to Fig. 1 for load A and B), and 

d) Load C is to be applied at a point in a plane 90° to that of loads A and B ( see Fig 4 )

APPENDIX A 

( Clause 4.1 ) 

MATERIALS FOR SIZE 50 FIFTH WHEEL KING PIN 

A-1. The fifth wheel king pins for semi-trailer end trailer are normally made from high tensile 
chromium molybdenum steels Some of the steels suitable for this purpose are given below: 

Steel Designation Relevant Indian Standard

and tempering { first revision )'

25Cn»MO« do fl 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Fifth wheel king pin is used for coupling semi-trailer with the fifth wheel of a prime mover or a 
load dividing dolly attached to the prime mover. 

This standard was first published in 1972. This revision includes the procedure for inspection 
of the king pin and the dimensional characteristics necessary for mounting and interchangeability In 
this revision, the values have also been converted into SI units 

This standard is being issued in two parts: 

Part 1 Size 50, and 
Part 2 Size 90. 

In the preparation of this standard, the assistance has been derived from ISO 337-1981 'Road 
vehicles 50 semi-trailer fifth wheel coupling pin — - Basic and mounting/interchangeability dimensions' 
issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 



Printed at Pnntrad Naw Delhi, India
